market_holds: The 2026-11-16 18:10 UTC sealed baseline has spot at $2.01. That is -19.6% over 5 days, -30.5% over 20 days, at the 52-week low and -73% from the 52-week high. The front chain is unusable (36 contracts of open interest, no two-sided ATM), so there is no implied move. The usual move is the median of 5 prior reactions, 10.7% (2 up, 3 down; +25.9% in May, -7.1% in August). Yahoo daily bars show a steady bleed from about $4.00 in mid-September to $2.00, with no single gap: about -1 to -4% a day, about 150k shares a day. No dated news explains it. Stockanalysis shows 32.7M shares, about a $65M market cap and short interest of 1.03M shares (10.2% of float, 3.1% of shares, undated). It shows 5 analysts at an average $8.25 target, which predates the sell-off and is plainly stale. As of the 2026-08-10 letter, guidance was FDA de novo authorization for GraftAssureDx targeted for year-end 2026. The FDA asked for more information in late July, which pauses the review clock. Q2 cash was $18.7M, Q2 free cash outflow about $10M, and per secondary summaries H2 burn is guided to about $8M a quarter. That implies about $10-11M at 9/30 (own arithmetic) and roughly one quarter of runway. The line the stock trades on is the FDA status and timing plus financing and dilution, not revenue (about $0.24M a quarter).
view: This is a pre-revenue single-catalyst diagnostics microcap. The two-month halving looks like the market pricing two things at once: (1) the FDA decision on GraftAssureDx has not arrived and may slip past year-end, since the Oct 14 sales-leader hire still calls the launch 'planned'; and (2) a near-certain equity raise, given about one quarter of cash left. The Q3 release is a shareholder letter plus a 10-Q. It will very likely repeat the FDA timing (on time or slipped) and show cash of about $10M with going-concern style language. There are three paths. The release could bundle FDA authorization, but a material authorization would normally be put out on its own at once, so this is low probability, about 10%, and a big upside move. The release could come with or be followed before the open by a discounted registered direct or warrant deal: the company has done one each February (2024, 2025, 2026) and runway now forces one, perhaps 20-30% inside the window, and a sharp down move. Most likely is a holding update, where a steady FDA tone after a 50% drawdown on a thin tape could give a small relief bounce and a slip into 2027 would extend the bleed. These roughly offset. A slight downward tilt comes from the financing overhang and from the stock still trading as a forced-seller tape into the print. I cannot show either direction is unpriced with dated evidence.

recommendation.reason: The reaction turns on two binary items, the FDA status and a financing, which the release may or may not settle inside the window. A 50% two-month drawdown already prices much of the dilution and delay risk. There is no implied-move anchor, and I found no dated datapoint since August that the price has not absorbed. The direction is near a coin flip with fat tails both ways.
recommendation.what_would_flip_it: Disclosure of FDA marketing authorization (or a firm, near-term response-complete timeline) without a simultaneous offering would make it a strong up move. A concurrent discounted offering, or a slip of the authorization target into 2027, would make it clearly down.

key_evidence.shows: The FDA requested additional information in late July with a 'clear, well-defined set of remaining items'. Cash was $18.7M, Q2 FCF about -$10M, Q2 revenue $239k, and the pro-forma diluted share count 36.9M.
H2 burn guided to about $8M a quarter (up from about $6M), authorization targeted before year-end 2026, financing needed to reach 2027.
A steady slide from $4.01 (2026-09-21) to $2.00 (2026-11-16) with no single news gap. Volume is about 60k-475k shares a day.
Only three releases since August (Oct 12 BTIG forum, Oct 14 sales leader hired for the 'planned' launch, Nov 5 Q3 date). No FDA authorization announced.
The Sept 8-K item 1.01 is only the Chronix merger amendment (10% royalty on CNI Monitor). It is not a financing.
32.7M shares, about a $65M market cap, short interest 10.2% of float, 5 analysts with an $8.25 average target (stale).
No 424B, S-3 or Form 4 since July. The last offering was the 2026-02-11 registered direct of $26M.
$18.7M minus about $8M Q3 burn gives about $10.7M at 9/30, about one quarter of runway, so a raise is near-certain before or soon after the FDA decision.

self_critique: Upside case: after a 50% drawdown into the print on a thin float with 10% short interest, any confirmation that the FDA response was submitted and a decision is weeks away could squeeze the stock 15-25% at the open, as in May (+25.9%). Downside case: the company has every incentive to raise immediately after filing the 10-Q, while its shelf is current and before the cash balance is public at about $10M. A pre-open registered direct at a 15-20% discount would hit the scored open directly. I cannot rank these two paths with evidence, so I stay near 50.
approach_notes: P4 ('priced in is a claim to prove') helped me avoid reading the drawdown as unpriced bad news: the bleed itself is the pricing. SEC www filings were unreachable without a declared user agent, but a mirror and EDGAR full text covered the gap. The playbook has no guidance for binary-catalyst pre-revenue names, where the release's content is mostly unknowable ahead of time.
